water.locator: R6-95(2018) Eq4-6, Tables1-3; thermodynamic properties derived from Helmholtz energy
water.scope: pure water; existing adapter limited to 293-500K and stable phases; current pressure bracket 90-110kPa

water_vapor.derivation: IAPWS ideal-limit h with the shared NIST energy offset; u=h-R_mix*T, as in ideal_water_vapor.py. Not the H2O Shomate segment that starts at 500K.

water_mass.scope: same liquid and vapor mole-to-mass convention, not rounded NIST water molecular weight

dry_cp.scope: borrowed original mixed-feed sludge dry Cp, 35-105C; not qualified for a brick or this synthetic wet combination

sources.carrier_caloric: Bundled NIST O2/N2 Shomate ranges and reference constants; see thermochemistry_file
sources.geometry_and_transport: Explicit virtual choices carried from D-B1; not observed material coefficients. Available volume excludes solid; solid volume is constant but not assigned a measured value.
sources.phase_constraint: Liquid amount fixed by a phase-impermeable, mechanically compliant separator with negligible energy/volume; common T/P. This ideal constraint permits heat/work but forbids interphase mass. No evaporation, condensation, sorption, capillarity, reaction, or full drying claim.
sources.numerics: Root-file analysis settings, not measured errors. Inverse brackets restrict the demonstrated path; brentq failures propagate.
sources.source_identity: Local metadata and runtime version are recorded; source bytes are not attested. No SHA generation/comparison and no legacy host digest construction.

facts.nist_locator: Gas Phase Heat Capacity row H; Liquid Phase Heat Capacity row H; gas standard entropy Chase row
facts.license_note: NIST SRD compilation copyright retained; no page redistribution permission claimed; only necessary numerical facts and attribution stored.

iapws_constants.locator: IAPWS R6-95(2018), printed p3 section2 equations1-3; fixed fitted R must not be replaced

ideal_formula_constants.locator: IAPWS R6-95(2018) printed p9 Table1; full residual coefficients in original PDF/Table2 and unmodified author source

gas_constant.derivation: R = exact Avogadro constant * exact Boltzmann constant
